income_calculation_rules.family_definition: Includes spouse, minor children, unmarried adult children, and dependent parents living together with no independent income.
income_calculation_rules.exclusions: Income of a widowed or abandoned woman in the family is NOT included in the family income calculation.

eligibility_criteria: Applicant or their family must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.
No minimum or maximum family income limit applies to request the certificate.
Students applying for scholarships must apply using their parent/guardian's family income details.

workflow_steps.details: User logs in with mobile number/email on edistrict.up.gov.in.
User inputs Aadhaar number and registered mobile number.
User receives and submits OTP on Aadhaar-linked mobile.
System displays Aadhaar-verified Name, DOB, and Photo. Automatically retrieves Family ID from server.
User fills family member details, occupation categories (labor, salary, business, agriculture), total family income, and uploads required documents.
Application routed to Lekhpal (Rural) or Revenue Inspector (Urban) to assess true family income.
Tehsildar reviews field verification report and digitally approves/issues the certificate.

vector_db_chunks.text: Service: Income Certificate (Aay Praman Patra), Uttar Pradesh Revenue Department. Issued by Tehsildar via eDistrict UP portal (edistrict.up.gov.in). Mandatory ₹30 fee. Requires Aadhaar e-KYC OTP authentication. Valid for both Rural and Urban residents.

Required Documents for Income Certificate (UP): 1. Applicant Photo (JPEG under 50KB, auto-fetched from Aadhaar). 2. Self-Certified Declaration Form (Swapramanit Ghoshna Patra). 3. Ration Card copy or Electricity Bill (Address Proof). 4. Latest Salary Slip / Payslip (Mandatory for salaried employees).

Income Calculation Rules UP: Family income includes total annual income of spouse, minor/unmarried children, and dependent parents living together. EXCLUSION: Income of a widowed or abandoned woman in the family is NOT included in the family income. Verified in the field by Lekhpal (Rural) or Revenue Inspector (Urban).

Application Procedure & Verification: Log into edistrict.up.gov.in. Complete Aadhaar mobile OTP authentication. Auto-fetch personal details and link Family ID. Declare annual income across categories (skilled labor, agriculture, salary, pension, private business). Upload enclosures and pay ₹30 fee. Local Lekhpal or Revenue Inspector conducts field inquiry before Tehsildar issues the certificate.
